controls.expected_rejection: The reversed fusion/fission gain-per-nucleon order fails exact formal and measured interval separation.
Any changed AME or IAEA source, source record, energy row, threshold clause or limitation is rejected.
A duplicated candidate or incomplete AME, fusion-table or fission-ledger census is rejected.
One universal dimensional threshold, conflated total/per-nucleon metrics or target access before sealing is rejected.

dimension_unit_boundary.external_reference_protocol: Formal binding-score enclosures and incident topologies seal first. AME keV-per-nucleon values and IAEA MeV, cross-section and threshold records remain post-seal dimensional targets attached to named reactions.

evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: The formal and AME representatives place fusion strictly above fission per nucleon and fission strictly above fusion in total; the IAEA D-T/U-235 comparison repeats both orders; and every charged, neutral, capture, spontaneous/internal and true/effective threshold class is retained.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if the sealed fusion-greater-per-nucleon relation or fission-greater-total relation fails the exact AME2020 uncertainty intervals or the registered IAEA D-T/U-235 energy comparison; if the IAEA charged effective-barrier, neutron-trigger, spontaneous/internal-barrier or captured-particle class is absent; if per-nucleon and total metrics are conflated; if any AME, fusion-table, fission-ledger, threshold or limitation row is omitted; if a source identity changes; or if target content enters prediction before its seal.

external_measurement_sources.measurement_body: Atomic Mass Data Center, Institute of Modern Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
International Atomic Energy Agency Nuclear Data Section

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: 5,832 complete per-nucleon, total, threshold-carrier, scope, access, metric, custody and extension forms
frozen_relation.exact_domain: positive exact nuclear counts, rational binding-score enclosures, held carrier labels and structural empty records
frozen_relation.statement: Fusion is greater per conserved nucleon, the registered heavy fission representative is greater in total, fusion has a charged two-boundary approach carrier, fission has neutral-capture or internal-surface carriers, and dimensional threshold values remain reaction-specific.

row_retention_policy: retain every AME positive-composite row, fusion-energy row, fission-energy component, reported total/interval, threshold class, rounded-mass limitation and adverse result
stop_condition: Halt after every formal, source, custody, energy, threshold, census, interval and adverse-control row is evaluated once, or immediately on any violation.
